purpose: Teach: 後述/費やす/沿う/起点/厳正/一味/ナマ/言い換え

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 詳細は資料の後述部分でご確認ください
lines.en: Please check the details in the latter section of the document.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight forward momentum. Professional but not cold. Assumes compliance without demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新企画は時間を費やす長期案件です
lines.en: Understood. The new project is a long-term initiative that will require significant time.
lines.style: Clear and responsive. Steady tempo, measured acknowledgment. Genuinely tracking — not just going through the motions. Slight weight on the scope of the commitment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ご要望に沿うサンプルを準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare samples that align with what they're asking for.
lines.style: Direct, purposeful instruction. Open, collaborative tone — inviting participation rather than dictating. Clean start, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議の起点となる議題を整理しました
lines.en: Understood. I've organized the agenda items that will set the direction for the meeting.
lines.style: Calm confirmation with quiet confidence. Unhurried pace. Competent — this work is done. Presents it as a foundation, not a burden.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 入社試験は厳正に審査しましょう
lines.en: We need to review the hiring assessments carefully and fairly.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Weight on the principle — this matters. Professional reserve. The tone of someone who won't compromise on this one.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規参入の一味と慎重に商談します
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate carefully with the new partners and conduct negotiations with appropriate caution.
lines.style: Steady, measured affirmation. Emphasizes the care being taken — not rushing. Aware of the stakes. Competent reassurance without overstatement.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料はナマのデータを添付しましょう
lines.en: Let's include the raw data in the document attachments.
lines.style: Practical instruction, no elaboration. Clear directive. Matter-of-fact — this is what's needed. Assumes understanding and follow-through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。専門用語を平易に言い換えて社内に共有します
lines.en: Understood. I'll convert the technical terminology into plain language and distribute it to the team.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly warmer. Finishes the exchange with quiet competence. Lighter touch — this is routine expertise. Slight ease at the end.
